root_cause: The OPT-125M GPTQ model export test failed because the numerical outputs from the OpenVINO-converted model deviate from the PyTorch framework outputs beyond the test's tolerance threshold. The maximum difference observed was 0.0687, indicating that the GPTQ quantized model conversion introduces numerical precision loss. This is likely caused by a regression in how quantized linear layers (TorchFusedQuantLinear) are handled during OV model export or inference, affecting the accuracy of GPTQ-quantized models.
